Syncrain --:--:--.- UTC

Every frame is computed from the UTC clock and the channel name. Open this on two devices with the same channel and they show the same rain at the same moment. It never repeats. Try every setting under Settings, then save them for your desktop.

Build and stream: the same stream and channel draw the same frame. NixOS snowflake by Simon Frankau and Tim Cuthbertson, CC BY 4.0.

Paste one instead

A settings file (config.json) or a symbols file (glyphs.json). You can also drop one on the page.

Then, in the syncrain folder: ./install.sh --config config.json. The desktop draws what you see here.
